properties.name: rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Global kill switch for the Redis-backed rate limiter (RateLimiterInterceptor). Set false to disable entirely, e.g. for local dev without Redis running.

properties.name: rate-limit.default-tier.capacity
properties.description: Max tokens (requests) the default tier's bucket can hold. Applies to any endpoint not matched by sensitive-paths or write-paths — ordinary browsing/reading (search, view a listing, currency rates).

properties.name: rate-limit.default-tier.refill-tokens
properties.description: Tokens added back to the default tier's bucket every refill-period-seconds.

properties.name: rate-limit.default-tier.refill-period-seconds
properties.description: How often (in seconds) the default tier's bucket refills by refill-tokens.

properties.name: rate-limit.write-tier.capacity
properties.description: Max tokens the write tier's bucket can hold. Applies to endpoints listed in write-paths — creating/editing/deleting listings.

properties.name: rate-limit.write-tier.refill-tokens
properties.description: Tokens added back to the write tier's bucket every refill-period-seconds.

properties.name: rate-limit.write-tier.refill-period-seconds
properties.description: How often (in seconds) the write tier's bucket refills by refill-tokens.

properties.name: rate-limit.sensitive-tier.capacity
properties.description: Max tokens the sensitive tier's bucket can hold. Applies to endpoints listed in sensitive-paths — anything that moves money or generates a lead a human contacts (bookings, cancellations, promotions, expressing interest). Deliberately the strictest tier, since these are exactly the actions fraud/spam patterns target.

properties.name: rate-limit.sensitive-tier.refill-tokens
properties.description: Tokens added back to the sensitive tier's bucket every refill-period-seconds.

properties.name: rate-limit.sensitive-tier.refill-period-seconds
properties.description: How often (in seconds) the sensitive tier's bucket refills by refill-tokens.

properties.name: rate-limit.sensitive-paths
properties.description: Endpoints checked against the sensitive tier, as 'METHOD:ant-pattern' entries (e.g. 'POST:/bookings/*/cancel'). Checked before write-paths, first match wins; unmatched requests fall into the default tier.

properties.name: rate-limit.write-paths
properties.description: Endpoints checked against the write tier, as 'METHOD:ant-pattern' entries (e.g. 'PUT:/listings/*'). Checked after sensitive-paths; unmatched requests fall into the default tier.

properties.name: auth.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the authentication service.

properties.name: wallet.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the wallet service. All payment execution (M-Pesa, PayPal, Stripe, Flutterwave, NOWPayments) lives there. This service calls its internal endpoints only: debit, transfer, transfer and commission lookups, and escrow hold, payout and lookup.

properties.name: mail-from
properties.description: The 'From' address EmailService uses on every booking/interest notification email. Not a Spring Boot-recognized mail property — Spring's mail starter has no such setting, this is purely this service's own convention.

properties.name: internal.service.api-key
properties.description: Shared internal-service API key sent as X-API-Key on service-to-service calls to wallet-service (/internal/payment, /internal/transfer, /internal/escrow and the lookups). Use the exact same value across every Premisave microservice — no default, since a wrong-but-present placeholder caused a confusing 401 at request time instead of a clear failure at startup.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens. Must match across all services.

properties.name: ad.promotion.daily-rate
properties.description: Daily rate charged for promoting an ad listing, in the default currency.

properties.name: ad.promotion.default-currency
properties.description: Default currency code used for ad promotion charges (e.g. USD).

properties.name: ad.promotion.expiry-check-cron
properties.description: Cron expression controlling how often AdPromotionService checks for and deactivates expired promotions. Standard 6-field Spring cron (seconds minutes hours day-of-month month day-of-week).

properties.name: booking.completion-check-cron
properties.description: Cron expression controlling how often BookingService checks for CONFIRMED bookings past their checkOut date and marks them COMPLETED. Standard 6-field Spring cron.

properties.name: frankfurter.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the Frankfurter currency exchange rate API. Display-only conversion now — actual payment settlement happens in wallet-service.

properties.name: frontend.url
properties.description: Frontend application URL used as the default CORS allowed-origin when cors.allowed-origins is not set.

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins, e.g. 'https://app.premisave.com,https://admin.premisave.com'. Falls back to frontend.url for single-origin setups.

properties.name: storage.mode
properties.description: LOCAL keeps images in storage.root; NETWORK keeps them on a mounted share.

properties.name: storage.root
properties.description: Image folder used when storage.mode is LOCAL.

properties.name: storage.public-base-url
properties.description: Origin that serves GET /images/{id}; used to build the image URLs saved on listings.

properties.name: storage.network.mount-path
properties.description: Where the network share is mounted on this machine.

properties.name: storage.network.directory
properties.description: Folder for this service inside the mount.

properties.name: storage.network.require-mount
properties.description: Refuse to start or serve if the mount path is not an actual mount.

properties.name: booking.reconciliation.pending-after-minutes
properties.description: Age after which a PENDING booking's payment is checked and, if needed, retried with the same reference. Keep it longer than the wallet-service call timeout so the original call has finished.

properties.name: email.outbox.max-attempts
properties.description: Send attempts before an outbox email is marked DEAD.

properties.name: wallet.commission.cache-seconds
properties.description: How long wallet-service's internal transfer commission rate (GET /internal/commission/rates) is reused before it is read again. Used only to tell the tenant what fee was added; wallet-service charges the fee itself.

properties.name: booking.max-stay-days
properties.description: Longest stay a single booking may span, in days or nights.

properties.name: booking.reconciliation.max-attempts
properties.description: Reconciliation attempts before a PENDING booking is parked as NEEDS_REVIEW for an admin.

properties.name: booking.reconciliation.lease-minutes
properties.description: How long one instance may work on a PENDING booking before another can pick it up.

properties.name: booking.reconciliation.retry-backoff-minutes
properties.description: Wait before a failed reconciliation attempt is repeated, multiplied by the attempt number.

properties.name: booking.reconciliation.batch-size
properties.description: PENDING bookings handled per reconciliation run.

properties.name: booking.reconciliation.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the pending-booking reconciliation job. Standard 6-field Spring cron.

properties.name: escrow.enabled
properties.description: Off by default: the tenant pays the owner directly in one transfer. When true, the booking payment is held by wallet-service in an escrow record (POST /internal/escrow/hold) and paid to the owner release-delay-hours after check-in, or refunded on cancellation. Wallet-service charges its commission once, on the hold, and nothing on the payouts. Needs the wallet-service escrow endpoints. Do not switch off while bookings are still held.

properties.name: escrow.release-delay-hours
properties.description: Hours after check-in before the owner is paid from the escrow hold. 0 pays at check-in time.

properties.name: escrow.release-check-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the job that pays owners for held bookings whose release delay has passed. Standard 6-field Spring cron.

properties.name: escrow.settlement-retry-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the job that retries cancellation payouts (refund and owner share) that did not go through. Standard 6-field Spring cron.

properties.name: escrow.max-attempts
properties.description: Payout attempts before a booking's escrow is parked as NEEDS_REVIEW.

properties.name: escrow.lease-minutes
properties.description: How long one instance may work on a booking's payout before another can pick it up.

properties.name: escrow.retry-backoff-minutes
properties.description: Wait before a failed payout is retried, multiplied by the attempt number.

properties.name: escrow.batch-size
properties.description: Bookings handled per escrow job run.

properties.name: email.outbox.poll-ms
properties.description: How often, in milliseconds, queued notification emails in the email_outbox collection are sent.

properties.name: email.outbox.retry-backoff-minutes
properties.description: Wait before a failed email is sent again, multiplied by the attempt number.

properties.name: email.outbox.keep-sent-days
properties.description: Days a sent outbox email is kept before it is deleted.

properties.name: email.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Outbox emails handled per run.

properties.name: storage.max-file-size-mb
properties.description: Largest accepted image upload, in megabytes. JPEG and PNG only.

properties.name: storage.max-images-per-listing
properties.description: Most images one listing may have.

properties.name: storage.network.protocol
properties.description: Protocol of the network share (SMB, NFS). Used in messages only; the operating system does the mounting.

properties.name: storage.network.host
properties.description: Host of the network share. Used in messages only.

properties.name: storage.network.share
properties.description: Name of the network share. Used in messages only.

values.description: Suppresses hostname resolution warnings from Spring Cloud.
